variable.name: personId
variable.description: Use the configured person ID, or 1 if it is not set

log.message: Looking up person record for ID: ${vars.personId}

variable.name: matches
variable.description: Find the person records whose ID matches the person ID

filter.description: Check whether a person record was found

log.description: Log a summary of the person record
log.message: Person found: Name = ${vars.matches[0].name}, Age = ${vars.matches[0].age}, DOB = ${vars.matches[0].dob}, Home = ${vars.matches[0].city}, ${vars.matches[0].state}

log.description: Log when no person matches the ID
log.message: No person record found for ID: ${vars.personId}
